clips.title: The story
paras: In Aldrassil, Alyissia trains young night elves to fight with strength and discipline. She teaches warriors how to defend the young world tree.

Alyissia trains young night elves inside Aldrassil, where they learn to fight with steel and shield instead of nature magic or the priesthood. Kaldorei forces are known for their Sentinels and stealthy archers, but danger across Kalimdor also calls for fighters who can hold the front line. Alyissia teaches the first techniques: how to direct battle fury, master a stance, and withstand the wild creatures and corrupted grells that press into Shadowglen.
